title: 2014 AMC 12B Problem 21
statement: In the figure, \(ABCD\) is a square of side length \(1.\) The rectangles \(JKHG\) and \(EBCF\) are congruent. What is \(BE?\)

solutions.text:
Let \(x = BE = GH = CF\) and \(\theta = \angle DHG = \angle AGJ\) \(= \angle FKH,\) with \(AD = GJ = HK = 1.\) In right triangle \(GDH,\) \(x \sin\theta = DG = 1 - \cos\theta,\) so \(x = \dfrac{1 - \cos\theta}{\sin\theta}.\)

Along side \(CD,\) \[ \begin{gathered} 1 = CF + FH + HD \\ = x + \sin\theta + x\cos\theta. \end{gathered} \] Substituting for \(x\) gives \[ \begin{gathered} 1 = \dfrac{(1-\cos\theta)(1+\cos\theta)}{\sin\theta} \\ {}+ \sin\theta \\ = \dfrac{\sin^2\theta}{\sin\theta} \\ {}+ \sin\theta \\ = 2\sin\theta. \end{gathered} \]

Hence \(\sin\theta = \tfrac12,\) so \(\theta = 30^\circ\) and \[ x = \dfrac{1 - \frac{\sqrt3}{2}}{\frac12} = 2 - \sqrt3. \]

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Along the top side, \(CD = CF + FH + HD = 1\) simplifies to \(2\sin\theta = 1\)
